changelog: Cancel link loading with Cancel, Back or an outside tap; leaving the result view closes pending work.
Superseded or cancelled link results no longer open a later download picker.
Settings transfers preserve Float and Long values and keep known credentials and local achievements private.
Combined imports clearly report unsupported CloudStream settings instead of claiming full success.
Update installation verifies every DEX payload header, length and integrity checksum with bounded reads.
Some quiet traces still wait to be found.
message: v728 - cancellable link loading and reliable settings transfers
